record.original_question: Is there a BCH-type bound for cyclic codes over Z4?

evidence.quote: Open Question 11.3. Is there any BCH bound for cyclic Z4-codes?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{Z}_4 = \mathbb{Z}/4\mathbb{Z}$ denote the ring of integers modulo $4$. A cyclic code of length $n$ over $\mathbb{Z}_4$ is a $\mathbb{Z}_4$-submodule $C \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_4^n$ closed under the cyclic shift $(c_0, c_1, \dots, c_{n-1}) \mapsto (c_{n-1}, c_0, \dots, c_{n-2})$. Equivalently, $C$ corresponds to an ideal of $\mathbb{Z}_4[x]/(x^n-1)$. The Lee weight on $\mathbb{Z}_4$ is defined by $w_L(0)=0,\, w_L(1)=w_L(3)=1,\, w_L(2)=2$, extended additively to $\mathbb{Z}_4^n$, and the Lee (or Hamming) distance of $C$ is the minimum Lee (or Hamming) weight of a nonzero codeword. 

Recall the classical BCH bound for cyclic codes over a finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$ (with $\gcd(n,q)=1$): if the defining set of $C$ contains $\delta-1$ consecutive powers of a primitive $n$-th root of unity, then the minimum Hamming distance of $C$ is at least $\delta$.

Problem: Establish a BCH-type lower bound on the minimum (Hamming or Lee) distance of an arbitrary cyclic code over $\mathbb{Z}_4$, expressed in terms of structural data (such as a defining set with respect to Galois extensions of $\mathbb{Z}_4$, or zeros of the generator polynomial) analogous to the classical BCH bound over finite fields.
artifact.status_search_result: Searches for a BCH-type bound specifically for cyclic codes over $\mathbb{Z}_4$ did not return a definitive, widely accepted general analogue. Various partial results and bounds for $\mathbb{Z}_4$-cyclic codes exist in the literature (e.g., generator structure $(fh, 2fg)$, Hensel lifting, related Hartmann–Tzeng-type bounds), but no canonical solution to the general question was identified. Status appears unresolved/unknown from accessible sources.

status_evidence.snippet: Theory of cyclic codes over Z4 including generator structure (fh, 2fg).
status_evidence.claim: Structure theory of Z4-cyclic codes is known, but a general BCH bound is not stated.

status_evidence.title: Some Good Cyclic and Quasi-Twisted Z4-Linear Codes
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs good Z4 cyclic codes; relies on computation rather than a BCH-type bound.
status_evidence.claim: Existing studies of Z4-cyclic codes proceed without a general BCH bound.
